entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Network-initiated message sent to reject a bearer resource modification request.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Indicates the reason for rejection of the bearer resource modification request.

entities.name: Bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure for modifying bearer resources, which can be rejected by the network.

relations.description: The BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message contains the EMM cause information element.
The bearer resource modification procedure includes the sending of a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message when the request is rejected.
